fb_device.description: Path to the frame buffer device to manipulate (e.g., /dev/fb0, /dev/fb1).

output_head.description: The output head to configure (0 is primary, 1 is secondary).

output_mode.description: The video output mode value (128=Monitor, 1=PAL TV, 2=NTSC TV).

output_map.description: Bitmask of outputs to connect (0=None, 1=Primary, 2=Secondary, 4=Digital Flat Panel).

enable_control.description: If true, enables control value get/set mode (-c).

show_blank_info.description: If true, displays information about blanking (-p).
